  We present Soft-NBCE, a lightweight extension that replaces discrete chunk selection with soft entropy-weighted chunk fusion. A temperature-scaled Softmax over predictive entropies assigns continuous weights to all chunks, enabling log-space aggregation across chunk-conditioned distributions. To partially compensate for the conditional independence assumption introduced by chunking, we propose Consistency Distillation, a LoRA-based self-distillation that constrains the chunked logit distribution toward a full-context teacher via KL-divergence. On LongBench multi-hop benchmarks, Soft-NBCE with Consistency Distillation improves consistently over NBCE-style baselines (MuSiQue F1: 0.310 vs.\ 0.275 for Vanilla NBCE; HotpotQA F1: 0.479 vs.\ 0.427) while maintaining retrieval accuracy (NIAH-32K: 0.909) at O(L^2/n) peak memory.

title: Adaptive Dense Evidence Refinement for Video Relational Reasoning for VRR-QA Challenge
authors: Yuyang Sun, Yongliang Wu, Xingyu Zhu, Yuxia Chen, Zhenxiang Jiang, Yangguang Ji, Wenbo Zhu, Yanxi Shi, Jay Wu, Shuo Wang, Xu Yang
abstract: VRR-QA evaluates whether video-language systems can infer spatial, temporal, viewpoint, depth, and visibility relations that are not always resolved by a single frame. We present an inference-only system built around adaptive test-time computation. The system first answers each question with a direct video-language model pass, then uses multiple lightweight views to find unstable questions. Only these difficult questions are routed to a high-budget dense evidence module that constructs timestamped frame observations, relation-specific probes, candidate verification, and conservative temporal aggregation. This design separates two problems that are often confused in video question answering: finding plausible alternative answers and deciding when a current answer should actually be changed. On the test split, the final system obtains 90.07 average accuracy and 87.81 macro average accuracy. The report focuses on the final test system and the implementation settings required to reproduce the adaptive dense verifier.

title: MiCU: End-to-End Smart Home Command Understanding with Large Language Model
authors: Haowei Han, Kexin Hu, Weiwei Cai, Debiao Zhang, Bin Qin, Yuxiang Wang, Jiawei Jiang, Xiao Yan, Bo Du
abstract: Command understanding systems in smart home ecosystems can automate device control and substantially improve user experience. However, while they perform well on precise utterances (e.g., "turn on the bedroom light"), they struggle with ambiguous or misaligned commands (e.g., "make the bedroom cozy"). Large language models (LLMs) generalize well across various domains and can outperform traditional rule-based systems on such tasks, but their effectiveness is often constrained by scarce domain-specific data, insufficient task-specific adaptation, and high computational costs. In this paper, we propose an automated training data synthesis workflow using user logs and LLMs; then we build MiCU, a domain-specific LLM that excels at command understanding. Specifically, we employ curriculum learning to inject domain knowledge into the base LLM, then we enhance its reasoning ability via cold-start training combined with reinforcement learning (RL) guided by domain-specific thinking rules. Additionally, we introduce a token compression technique that condenses device description into a single special token, substantially reducing inference overhead and enabling \model-fast, an efficient variant optimized for long inputs. Extensive experiments show that MiCU significantly outperforms baselines, with an average accuracy gain of 20.01% across all device categories. We have deployed MiCU in the Xiaomi Home app, receiving approximately 1.7 million page views per day. Production evaluations show that MiCU reduces user correction rate by 1.57% and increases human audited accuracy by 32.05%. Our data and code are available at https://github.com/xiaomi-research/iot_spec_llm

title: Temporal Evidence Routing with Structured Visual Evidence for TimeLogicQA
authors: Yuyang Sun, Yongliang Wu, Xingyu Zhu, Yuxia Chen, Zhenxiang Jiang, Yangguang Ji, Wenbo Zhu, Yanxi Shi, Jay Wu, Shuo Wang, Xu Yang
abstract: TimeLogicQA evaluates whether video question answering systems can reason over temporal relations such as event existence, ordering, persistence, boundary conditions, and overlap. We address this task with a visual evidence routing pipeline that separates perception from symbolic temporal reasoning. The system first parses each question into event targets, answer mode, candidate options, and temporal operators. It then routes videos according to duration and operator difficulty, using ordered full-frame evidence for short clips and event-focused candidate windows for long videos. A multimodal large language model produces structured visual evidence for the relevant events, while programmatic verifiers recover dense action intervals and a deterministic reducer applies operator-specific temporal rules to produce the final answer. Conservative fusion accepts an answer only when the visual evidence, temporal program, and confidence checks agree, reducing noisy answer flips. On the official test evaluation, our final system achieves an AvgAcc of 81.8.

title: How (and when) can you fit examples to logic-based hypothesis classes over infinite structures?
authors: Michael Benedikt, Alessio Mansutti
abstract: We study fitting problems, sometimes called ``training problems'', where we have a finite sample consisting of inputs and outputs, and we want to know whether there is a function in a certain class that could produce these outputs, exactly or approximately, on the given inputs. We focus on the computational and descriptive complexity of fitting for logically-defined classes in common decidable structures, like the real ordered field and Presburger arithmetic, and also for broader classes defined via combinatorial or model-theoretic properties. We isolate the complexity of these fitting problems, with particular attention to cases where we can use queries in a natural query language over the sample to determine whether a sample is fittable.

title: Digging Up Citations: FOSSIL, a Dataset and Workflow for Reference Extraction in Law and the Humanities
authors: Luca Foppiano, Christian Boulanger
abstract: Citation extraction tools are designed for the structured end-of-document bibliographies of the natural sciences, but law and humanities scholarship cites references primarily in footnotes, where bibliographic data is interleaved with commentary and cross-references and varies widely across languages and styles. To address the scarcity of suitable gold-standard resources, we present FOSSIL (Footnote-based Open-access SSH Scientific Instance Labels), an openly licensed multilingual dataset of 96 annotated scholarly articles containing over 7,600 footnote-embedded references, together with PDF-TEI Editor (a collaborative web annotation tool), a documented seven-annotator workflow, and a Grobid specialization for footnote-based citations. In end-to-end evaluation, the specialized pipeline nearly doubles extraction quality over default Grobid (micro-F1 from 0.36 to 0.72), driven largely by improved recall, while showing that substantial headroom remains for cross-references and mixed-content footnotes. This extended abstract presents work in progress; annotations of citations segmentation and parsing, and cross-reference resolution are ongoing.
comment: This is an extended abstract, peer-reviewed and presented at CiteX2026 https://sites.google.com/view/workshop-on-citation-extractio/startseite

title: LeAP: Learnable Adaptive Permutation for Feature Selection in Heterogeneous and Sparse Recommender Systems
authors: Yihong Huang, Chen Chu, Fei Chen, Yu Lin, Ruiduan Li, Zhihao Li
abstract:
Modern industrial recommender systems rely on thousands of heterogeneous features -- ranging from low-dimensional scalars (e.g., statistical value) to high-dimensional embeddings (e.g., user-id embeddings, MLP representations) -- to achieve high-precision predictions. Given the immense computational costs associated with training, efficient feature selection is critical. However, existing methods encounter three primary bottlenecks: (1) they typically assume uniform feature dimensions or require costly mapping to a fixed size; (2) they struggle with extreme sparsity, where the majority of features (e.g., 99%+) remain at default values; and (3) traditional permutation-based approaches are computationally prohibitive in large-scale settings.
  To address these challenges, we propose LeAP (Learnable Adaptive Permutation), a novel, model-agnostic plug-in module for feature selection. LeAP transforms the inefficient random permutation process into a learnable mechanism, significantly accelerating the evaluation of feature importance. In addition, we introduce an adaptive regularization strategy tailored for heterogeneous dimensions and extreme sparsity, enabling superior feature importance ranking results across asymmetric input spaces. Experiments on four public recommendation datasets demonstrate that LeAP achieves state-of-the-art performance. Furthermore, LeAP has been deployed in a large-scale industrial search ranking model with over a billion daily requests and a 2TB model parameter scale. In this real-world scenario involving 12,000+ total feature dimensions, LeAP successfully identified and removed over 3,600 redundant dimensions without performance degradation, which is 2 to 10 times the ability of compared baseline methods.

title: R^3: Composed Video Retrieval via Reasoning-Guided Recalling and Re-ranking
authors: Zixu Li, Yupeng Hu, Zhiheng Fu, Zhiwei Chen, Weili Guan, Liqiang Nie
abstract: The CoVR-R challenge evaluates composed video retrieval, where a system must retrieve a target video from a large gallery given a reference video and a textual edit instruction. This setting is not a standard video-text retrieval problem: the query is defined by both the visual evidence in the source video and the transformation implied by the edit. A strong embedding model can provide scalable candidate recall, but it may under-express target-side consequences such as state changes, action replacement, object preservation, or temporal consistency. A pairwise multimodal reranker can verify such details more directly, but exhaustive reranking over the full gallery is computationally infeasible. We present $\mathbb{R}^3$, a zero-shot composed video retrieval pipeline built around Reasoning-guided Recalling and Reranking. The core idea is to turn the source-edit query into a reasoning-grounded retrieval program rather than treating the edit text as a short caption. First, the model generates a reasoning trace that describes the expected target video after applying the edit. Then the trace is encoded together with the source video as a reasoning-augmented query, and its retrieval score is fused with the base composed query through an agreement-gated residual rule. At last, a re-ranker verifies the recalled candidates with direct source-candidate comparison. Experiments have demonstrated the effectiveness of our method in addressing this challenge. Codes are available on https://github.com/Lee-zixu/R-3.

title: Magnum.np.distributed: Accelerating Finite Difference Micromagnetic Simulations with Multiple GPUs
authors: Tsz Chung Cheng, Yuichiro Kurokawa, Hiromi Yuasa
abstract: Micromagnetic simulations are essential tools in nanomagnetism and spintronics research. Although widely adopted solvers like Mumax3 and the Python-native magnum.np use GPU acceleration to improve performance, these tools are limited to single-device computation. In this work, we present the first Python-native multi-GPU micromagnetic framework by extending magnum.np with PyTorch Distributed. This leverages high-speed communication and computation across multiple GPUs while retaining the benefits of ease of installation, platform-agnostic design, and compatibility with Python. For computationally intensive demagnetisation effective-field calculations, we achieve a 7.0x speedup across 8 GPUs connected via NVLink, whereas Halo exchange required for Heisenberg exchange shows limited scaling due to kernel dispatch latency. We also demonstrated the framework's versatility by achieving a 6.8x speedup in demagnetisation field computation on CPU with NUMA pinning via the MPI backend of PyTorch Distributed. Faster turnaround times will enable researchers to explore larger, more complex systems and accelerate the design cycle for novel spintronic devices.

title: Tether-Aware Dynamic Collision Avoidance for USV-HROV Systems
authors: Yang Gu, Ziyang Hong, Xuanlin Chen, Hao Wei, Cheng Wang, Shujie Yang, Yulin Si
abstract: Heterogeneous marine robotic systems composed of an unmanned surface vehicle (USV) and a hybrid remotely operated vehicle (HROV) have shown great potential for subsea cable inspection. In such missions, the USV tracks the HROV at the surface while supplying power and communication through an umbilical tether. However, dynamic collision avoidance for the USV during HROV tracking is challenging because the submerged tether may scrape against passing vessels, while evasive maneuvers can enlarge the USV--HROV separation, thereby increasing the likelihood of tether tautness and compromising HROV operations. To address these challenges, this work proposes a tether-aware dynamic collision avoidance method for a USV tracking an HROV. First, a tether safety-aware planar domain is introduced to represent the three-dimensional collision risk between the tether and obstacle vessels without an explicit tether shape model. Second, a tether tautness-aware velocity obstacle method is developed to achieve safe avoidance while reducing the likelihood of tether tautness. Finally, the method is integrated with line-of-sight guidance to coordinate HROV tracking and collision avoidance. Gazebo-based simulations show that the proposed method avoids dynamic obstacle vessels while maintaining tether safety and reducing the likelihood of tether tautness during USV evasive maneuvers.

title: HASTE: Hardware-Aware Dynamic Sparse Training for Large Output Spaces
authors: Nasib Ullah, Jinbin Zhang, Jean Lucien Randrianantenaina, Erik Schultheis, Rohit Babbar
abstract: Extreme multi-label classification (XMC) involves learning models over large output spaces with millions of labels, making the output layer a memory-compute bottleneck. While sparsity-based methods reduce arithmetic complexity, they often fail to yield proportional speedups due to irregular memory access, poor hardware utilization, or reliance on auxiliary architectural components in long-tailed regimes. We introduce group-shared fixed fan-in sparsity, a semi-structured output-layer design in which semantically related labels share a sparse input pattern while retaining independent weights. This grouping introduces a task-aligned inductive bias -- encouraging related labels to share feature subsets -- while reducing index memory overhead, increasing feature reuse across labels, and enabling efficient GPU execution via custom CUDA kernels that leverage modern accelerator primitives. As an alternative to auxiliary objectives, we exploit the long-tailed structure of XMC by decomposing the output layer into a small dense head over frequent labels and a group-shared sparse tail over the remainder, providing an informative gradient pathway while preserving the memory benefits of sparsity. Through kernel-level microbenchmarking, we show that group-shared fixed fan-in translates arithmetic reductions into practical wall-clock gains, achieving up to $4.4\times$ speedup in the forward pass and up to $25\times$ speedup in backward passes over standard fixed fan-in sparsity, while operating within a few percent of a FLOPs-matched dense bottleneck. Across large-scale XMC benchmarks, our approach matches or improves precision@k over prior sparse baselines, while narrowing the performance gap to dense.

title: Diagnosing LLM Arbitration Behavior over Pre-evidence Epistemic States in RAG-based Fact-Checking
authors: Yuxi Sun, Wenbo Shang, Wei Gao, Xin Huang, Jing Ma
abstract: In RAG-based fact-checking, LLMs are increasingly used as verifiers to check given claims against retrieved evidence. Their parametric knowledge can induce pre-evidence tendencies that may conflict with the retrieved context, yet existing evaluation frameworks do not characterize such prior-context discrepancy or measure how verifiers arbitrate between parametric and contextual signals. We introduce \textsc{PAVE} (\emph{Prior-Aware Verifier Evaluation}), a diagnostic testbed that stratifies an LLM verifier into four epistemic states based on the correctness and confidence of its pre-evidence prior and evaluates its arbitration behavior on this new benchmark, i.e., whether it persists in correct prior under misleading evidence, and whether it corrects wrong prior when accurate evidence is provided. Experiments across seven LLMs reveal unreliable and highly model-dependent prior-context arbitration, highlighting the importance of verifier selection for real-world RAG-based fact-checking applications. Based on these findings, we propose a lightweight JSD-based test-time arbitration method that improves factual reliability without modifying the underlying model, achieving competitive performance across diverse LLM families.

title: From Reward-Free Representations to Preferences: Rethinking Offline Preference-Based Reinforcement Learning
authors: Jun-Jie Yang, Chia-Heng Hsu, Kui-Yuan Chen, Ping-Chun Hsieh
abstract: Preference-based reinforcement learning (PbRL) avoids explicit reward engineering by learning from pairwise human preference feedback. Existing offline PbRL methods typically follow a two-stage pipeline, first learning a reward or preference model from labeled preferences and then performing offline RL on unlabeled data. We revisit offline PbRL through the lens of reward-free representation learning (RFRL) from the zero-shot RL literature, and propose a new training framework that first learns latent successor-measure representations from reward-free offline data, followed by contrastive search and fine-tuning using preference data. Through extensive experiments and ablations, we show that our method achieves superior preference efficiency over offline PbRL baselines. This work is the first to connect RFRL with PbRL, highlighting its potential as a feedback-efficient solution. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/rl-bandits-lab/FB-PbRL.

title: Rank-Aware Quantile Activation for Motion-Robust Crop Segmentation in UAV Imagery
authors: Abinav Kiran, Sravan Danda, Aditya Challa, Sougata Sen, Daya Sagar B S
abstract: Motion blur from high-speed UAV acquisition de-grades semantic segmentation on rare texture-dependent classes with high agronomic value. Standard CNNs rely on high-frequency magnitude features that blur destroys, causing statistical erasure of minority signals. We propose Dual Quantile Activation (QAct), a rank-aware block replacing magnitude gating with instance-level rank normalization. Evaluated onAgriculture-Vision 2021 across zero-shot and blur-supervised regimes at multiple severities, QAct is the dominant architectural factor: it delivers consistent mIoU gains over ReLU across both regimes and all severities, with strongest gains on rare structural and texture-dependent classes. Some dominant classes (water,planter skip) show mixed per-class performance under distillation. At moderate blur, zero-shot QAct outperforms distillation-trained ReLU; across all severities, Distill-QAct achieves best performance, confirming rank aware activation and blur-domain training are complementary robustness sources.

title: A Per-Component Diagnostic Protocol for Neural HJB-PIDE Solvers under Control-Dependent Lévy Jumps
authors: R. Drissi
abstract: We propose a five-step diagnostic protocol for residual-trained neural HJB-PIDE solvers with control-dependent Lévy jumps, targeting a general failure mode of neural PDE methods: a learned solution can match headline scalar diagnostics while miscomputing an operator inside its training loss. The protocol pairs each neural solve with at least one from-scratch independent reference, decomposes the Hamiltonian into drift, diffusion, compensator, and nonlocal-integral components across a u-grid, and compares the value function and its low-order derivatives over a (t,x) grid before any argmax comparison. Applied to a standard CRRA-Merton-Variance-Gamma benchmark, it isolates a missing 1/2-mixture factor in the neural method's importance-proposal density that scaled the nonlocal integral by exactly half - a textbook signature of a constant proposal scale error, invisible to longer training, grid refinement, and truncation sweeps. With the bug corrected, four references - two finite-difference solvers with disjoint discretizations, the neural solver, and a semi-analytic scalar baseline obtained from CRRA homogeneity - agree on the optimal control to within ~2%. The constant-coefficient CRRA benchmark collapses by homogeneity to a scalar maximization, so the scalar baseline is the efficient method here; the contribution is the protocol, applicable in principle to non-homogeneous and higher-dimensional settings where neural HJB-PIDE solvers are genuinely needed. The episode is a concrete instance of a broader neural-PDE verification failure: pointwise agreement of a learned value or control can coexist with a systematically wrong nonlocal operator, so per-component and surface-level checks are needed before trusting the argmax policy.

title: Frontlines and faultlines: How the Russo-Ukrainian conflict reshapes the landscape of scientific research
authors: Yang Ding
abstract: Geopolitical conflict poses significant challenges to research and innovation policy by disrupting scientific systems and talent mobility. This study analyzes the impact of the conflict between Russia and Ukraine, particularly the escalations in 2014 and 2022, on the academic landscapes of both countries. We analyzed publication data from 2000 to 2023, encompassing over 1.8 million papers, one million scholars, and 2300 institutions across Ukraine and Russia, alongside collaboration data spanning 193 regions. We tracked scholar migration, research topics, and evolving international networks. Significant migration followed the 2014 and 2022 events, causing severe talent loss and a sharp decline in domestic research visibility in Ukraine. Migrated Ukrainian scholars shifted toward internationalized basic sciences, whereas active scholars who remained focused on applied fields relevant to national resilience and reconstruction. Both groups experienced decreased output in resource dependent fields, particularly medical research. Global networks fractured: traditional ties between Russia and the West, as well as between Ukraine and Russia, dissolved. These were replaced by new alignments between Russia and neighboring countries, and between Ukraine and the West. Migrating Ukrainian scholars face challenges assuming key research roles, though academic communities in smaller host nations showed a trend toward leadership positions. Concurrently, Russian scholars saw a decline in research prominence across most countries due to international sanctions. These findings reveal how conflict disrupts national scientific capacity, fractures global research networks, and affects individual academic careers, highlighting the need for targeted policies to support vulnerable academic communities during crises.

title: STARFISH: faST Accuracy Recovery in pruned networks From Internal State Healing
authors: Shir Maon, Odelia Melamed, Adi Shamir
abstract: Pruning is a process designed to reduce the number of weights in a large neural network. This can substantially speed up inference but might cause a considerable reduction in the model's accuracy, and thus it is usually followed by a healing process that regains some of the lost accuracy. In this paper, we propose a new healing method, STARFISH, that can recover (most of) the accuracy of any pruned network efficiently. The main idea of STARFISH is to optimize the pruned network to align with the original network's internal state representations using a tiny calibration set of unlabeled examples. For the common case of removing 50% of the weights, STARFISH healing improves the recovered accuracy by up to 22% over the state-of-the-art methods on ViT-based networks. Its advantage is even more pronounced under aggressive pruning. For example, after eliminating 75% of the weights in a DeiT-B network for ImageNet, STARFISH uses only 0.4% of the number of training images as a calibration set and recovers 82% of the original dense accuracy, whereas competing recovery techniques reach only 40% of the dense model accuracy.

title: How Proposal Novelty, Topical Diversity, and Theory-Practice Balance Shape Scholarly Outcomes in Funded Education Research
authors: Yunfeng Gao, Yuxuan Xiao, Jiaming Zhang, Yang Ding
abstract: Education research occupies a distinctive position in public science because it is expected to advance scholarly knowledge while also informing learning, teaching, participation, and workforce development. This study examines how the intellectual characteristics of NSF-funded education proposals are associated with the subsequent academic performance of funded scholars. Linking 8,715 NSF education awards from 1990 to 2020 with 84,519 publications by principal investigators, the analysis focuses on four major NSF education divisions that collectively span undergraduate and graduate levels, formal and informal learning environments, and inclusive educational initiatives. Proposal novelty is measured as semantic distance from prior funded projects within the same division, topical diversity as breadth across latent research themes, and intellectual orientation as theoretical, practical, or balanced. The results show that NSF education funding is consistently associated with higher publication output across divisions. However, this increase is not accompanied by stronger citation performance or higher journal-level visibility; citation and CiteScore estimates are often negative, particularly in later decades. Proposal novelty shows limited and uneven associations with post-award outcomes, whereas topical diversity is more clearly related to publication growth in some divisions but weaker citation-based performance in others. Balanced proposals that integrate theoretical and practical aims display the most favourable overall profile, combining positive publication associations with fewer negative citation-based patterns. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating education research funding through multiple academic outcomes and division-specific research contexts.

title: Local MixVR: Breaking the Communication-Sample Dependence in Distributed Learning
authors: Tehila Dahan, Bassel Hamoud, Roie Reshef, Martin Jaggi, Kfir Y. Levy
abstract: Communication overhead is a crucial bottleneck in scalable distributed learning. While existing methods aim to efficiently utilize data points, such as Local SGD, Minibatch SGD, and their accelerated variants, they still exhibit communication-round complexity that scales with the total number of samples $N$. In this paper, we introduce Local MixVR, a distributed framework that integrates local updates with variance-reduction techniques to mitigate local noise. We show that Local MixVR is the first distributed method to eliminate the dependence of communication complexity on $N$, achieving a complexity that scales only with the number of workers $M$. In common regimes where $M<O\left(N^{1/4}\right)$, Local MixVR outperforms the state-of-the-art Minibatch Accelerated SGD baseline, bridging a long-standing gap in distributed optimization and establishing a new paradigm for communication-efficient training.

title: Tokenized but Illiquid? Evidence from Real-World Asset Markets
authors: Rischan Mafrur
abstract: Real-world asset tokenization is often presented as a mechanism for improving the liquidity of traditionally illiquid assets. However, on-chain representation and secondary-market liquidity are distinct outcomes. This paper examines whether tokenized real-world assets exhibit meaningful observed liquidity and identifies the token characteristics associated with higher market activity. Using token-level data from RWA.xyz and supplemental contract-level observations from Etherscan, the study constructs an Ethereum-based monthly panel of non-stablecoin real-world assets across three prominent categories: U.S. Treasury-backed tokens, gold-backed commodity tokens, and private-credit-related tokens. Liquidity is measured using turnover, active addresses, and an active-month indicator. The empirical design combines descriptive statistics, non-parametric group tests, and exploratory panel regressions suited to short and sparse token histories. The results show substantial heterogeneity across asset categories. Gold-backed tokens exhibit broader holder bases and more persistent on-chain activity than many Treasury and private-credit-related products, while outstanding asset value alone does not reliably predict observed liquidity. The paper contributes to the literature by developing a clearer empirical measurement framework for real-world-asset liquidity and showing that tokenization and liquidity should be analyzed as distinct outcomes.
zh_title: 代币化但缺乏流动性？来自真实世界资产（RWA）市场的证据
translation: 真实世界资产（RWA）代币化通常被认为是一种提高传统非流动性资产流动性的机制。然而，链上表示与二级市场流动性是两个截然不同的结果。本文探讨了代币化的真实世界资产是否表现出明显的实际流动性，并识别了与更高市场活跃度相关的代币特征。利用来自RWA.xyz的代币级数据以及来自Etherscan的补充合约级观测数据，本研究构建了一个基于以太坊的非稳定币真实世界资产月度面板，涵盖三个主要类别：美债支持的代币、黄金支持的商品代币以及私人信贷相关代币。流动性通过换手率、活跃地址和活跃月份指标进行衡量。实证设计结合了描述性统计、非参数组检验以及适用于简短且稀疏代币历史的探索性面板回归。结果显示，不同资产类别之间存在实质性的异质性。相比于许多美债和私人信贷相关产品，黄金支持的代币表现出更广泛的持有者群体和更持久的链上活动，而仅靠未偿资产价值并不能可靠地预测观察到的流动性。本文通过为真实世界资产流动性开发一个更清晰的实证衡量框架，并表明代币化和流动性应作为不同的结果进行分析，从而对文献做出了贡献。
tldr: 研究表明，真实世界资产（RWA）代币化并不等同于流动性。分析发现黄金代币的流动性显著好于美债和私人信贷代币，且资产规模无法预测其链上流动性。
ai_comments: 这篇论文切中了当前Web3和传统金融交叉领域的热点，其重要价值在于挑战了“代币化即自动带来流动性”的行业乐观假设。论文的创新之处在于为RWA流动性建立了一个多维度的实证衡量框架（换手率、活跃地址等）。局限性在于受限于当前RWA市场的发展阶段，样本数据历史较短且相对稀疏，且研究主要集中于以太坊网络，可能未涵盖其他新兴公链的生态。
motivation: 尽管真实世界资产（RWA）代币化被广泛宣传为提高传统非流动性资产流动性的手段，但链上代币化与二级市场的实际流动性是两码事。本文旨在探究代币化RWA是否真的具有实际流动性，并找出与高市场活跃度相关的代币特征。
method: 利用来自RWA.xyz的代币级数据和Etherscan的补充合约级数据，构建了一个以太坊上非稳定币RWA（涵盖美债、黄金和私人信贷代币）的月度面板数据集。通过换手率、活跃地址和活跃月份指标来衡量流动性，并采用描述性统计、非参数组间检验和探索性面板回归进行实证分析。
results: 不同类别的RWA在流动性上表现出显著的异质性。黄金支持的代币比美债和私人信贷代币拥有更广泛的持有人基础和更持久的链上活跃度。此外，仅凭代币的未偿资产价值（规模）无法可靠地预测其在二级市场的实际流动性。
conclusion: 代币化与流动性是两个截然不同的结果，不能等同视之。未偿资产规模并不能作为流动性的可靠预测指标。研究为理解和评估RWA在去中心化金融生态中的实际表现提供了清晰的实证衡量框架。

title: Spiking and Event-driven Neuromorphic Mamba Models for Efficient Speech Recognition
authors: Tauseef Ahmed, Tao Sun, Jeronimo Castrillon, Kanishkan Vadivel, Guangzhi Tang
abstract: Deep learning has greatly advanced automatic speech recognition (ASR), enabling widespread deployment on edge devices such as smartphones and smart home systems. However, the computational and energy demands of deep neural networks pose significant challenges for such resource-constrained deployments, introducing latency and limiting real-time interaction. Neuromorphic computing offers a promising solution by introducing activation sparsity through spiking neural networks (SNNs) and event-driven neural networks, converting dense operations into sparse computations. However, a study that evaluates the hardware benefits of different neuromorphic strategies remains lacking for ASR. This paper explores spiking and event-driven neuromorphic neural networks to improve activation sparsity in the state-of-the-art SpeechMamba model for ASR. We introduce an event-driven SpeechMamba with FATReLU activation, achieving over 60% activation sparsity with less than 1% accuracy degradation on LibriSpeech. We also propose a spiking SpeechMamba that attains over 70% sparsity while using 30% fewer parameters than comparable SNNs. Finally, we develop a cycle-accurate event-driven simulator enabling flexible algorithm-hardware co-exploration, which helps us identify computational bottlenecks and yields over 10% additional efficiency improvements.
zh_title: 用于高效语音识别的脉冲与事件驱动类脑 Mamba 模型
translation: 深度学习极大地推动了自动语音识别（ASR）的发展，使其能够在智能手机和智能家居系统等边缘设备上广泛部署。然而，深度神经网络的计算和能量需求对这类资源受限的部署提出了重大挑战，引入了延迟并限制了实时交互。类脑计算通过脉冲神经网络（SNN）和事件驱动神经网络引入激活稀疏性，将密集操作转化为稀疏计算，从而提供了一种极具前景的解决方案。然而，目前仍缺乏针对 ASR 评估不同类脑策略硬件效益的研究。本文探索了脉冲和事件驱动的类脑神经网络，以提高最先进的 SpeechMamba 模型在 ASR 任务中的激活稀疏性。我们引入了具有 FATReLU 激活函数的事件驱动 SpeechMamba，在 LibriSpeech 上实现了超过 60% 的激活稀疏度，且准确率下降不到 1%。我们还提出了一种脉冲 SpeechMamba，在比同类 SNN 减少 30% 参数的同时，实现了超过 70% 的稀疏度。最后，我们开发了一个周期精确的事件驱动模拟器，实现了灵活的算法-硬件协同探索，这有助于我们识别计算瓶颈，并带来了超过 10% 的额外效率提升。
tldr: 本文将脉冲与事件驱动类脑计算引入 SpeechMamba 模型，在保持高精度的同时实现了超 60%~70% 的激活稀疏度，并开发了协同模拟器，显著提升了语音识别的计算效率。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地将目前先进的 Mamba 架构（SpeechMamba）与类脑计算（脉冲神经网络和事件驱动网络）相结合，旨在解决自动语音识别（ASR）在边缘设备部署时的功耗与延迟问题。其主要亮点在于不仅在算法层面实现了极高的激活稀疏度（超 60% 和 70%）且几乎不损失精度，还开发了周期精确的硬件模拟器进行算法-硬件协同设计，这为类脑语音识别芯片的实际落地提供了非常有价值的参考。
motivation: 尽管深度学习极大促进了自动语音识别（ASR）在边缘设备上的部署，但深度神经网络巨大的计算和能量需求带来了高延迟并限制了实时交互。类脑计算（如脉冲神经网络和事件驱动网络）通过引入激活稀疏性来减少计算量，但目前仍缺乏针对 ASR 任务评估不同类脑策略硬件效益的研究。本研究旨在填补这一空白，提高 ASR 模型的计算效率。
method:
本研究探索了脉冲和事件驱动类脑神经网络在 SpeechMamba 模型中的应用，以提升其激活稀疏度。具体方法包括：
1. 引入了带有 FATReLU 激活函数的事件驱动 SpeechMamba 模型。
2. 提出了一种参数量更低的脉冲 SpeechMamba 模型。
3. 开发了一个周期精确（cycle-accurate）的事件驱动模拟器，用于算法与硬件的协同探索及识别计算瓶颈。
results:
1. 事件驱动的 SpeechMamba（结合 FATReLU 激活）在 LibriSpeech 数据集上实现了超过 60% 的激活稀疏度，且准确率下降不到 1%。
2. 脉冲 SpeechMamba 实现了超过 70% 的激活稀疏度，同时比同类脉冲神经网络（SNN）减少了 30% 的参数。
3. 周期精确的事件驱动模拟器成功帮助识别了计算瓶颈，并带来了额外超过 10% 的效率提升。
conclusion: 通过将脉冲和事件驱动的类脑技术应用于 SpeechMamba 模型，并辅以算法-硬件协同模拟，可以在极少精度损失的前提下显著提高 ASR 模型的激活稀疏度、降低参数量并提升计算效率，为资源受限边缘设备上的高效语音识别提供了切实可行的解决方案。

title: HakushoBench: A Japanese Chart and Table VQA Benchmark from Governmental White Papers
authors: Issa Sugiura, Shuhei Kurita, Yusuke Oda, Naoaki Okazaki
abstract: Understanding chart and table images is essential for applying vision-language models (VLMs) to real-world document understanding. While English benchmarks have advanced rapidly, non-English counterparts remain scarce, leaving it unclear whether this progress generalizes across languages. A key obstacle is the difficulty of collecting realistic and diverse non-English chart and table images at scale. To address this, we leverage governmental white papers as a scalable source for benchmark construction beyond English, as they contain naturally occurring charts and tables across diverse formats and domains and are freely accessible in many countries. As a first instantiation, we introduce HakushoBench, a challenging Japanese chart and table VQA benchmark built from 33 governmental white papers. HakushoBench contains 2,053 images spanning over 10 image types, with manually annotated QA pairs, designed to assess deep and holistic understanding of charts and tables, rather than local visual cues alone. Experiments across a broad range of VLMs demonstrate that HakushoBench remains challenging for open-weight models: the best open-weight model achieves only 58.6% accuracy, and a 34.9-point gap between open-weight and proprietary models highlights substantial room for improvement in complex chart and table understanding. We release our dataset and code.
zh_title: HakushoBench：基于政府白皮书的日语图表和表格视觉问答基准
translation: 理解图表和表格图像对于将视觉语言模型（VLM）应用于现实世界的文档理解至关重要。虽然英文基准发展迅速，但非英文基准仍然稀缺，这使得这些进展是否能推广到其他语言变得不确定。一个关键障碍是难以大规模收集真实且多样的非英文图表和表格图像。为了解决这一问题，我们利用政府白皮书作为构建非英文基准的可扩展来源，因为它们包含在不同格式和领域中自然产生的图表和表格，并且在许多国家都可以免费获取。作为首个具体实现，我们推出了 HakushoBench，这是一个由 33 份政府白皮书构建的、极具挑战性的日语图表和表格 VQA（视觉问答）基准。HakushoBench 包含 2,053 张图像，涵盖 10 多种图像类型，并配有人工标注的问答对，旨在评估对图表和表格的深度和整体理解，而非仅靠局部视觉线索。对广泛视觉语言模型（VLM）的实验表明，HakushoBench 对开源模型仍然极具挑战性：表现最好的开源模型仅实现了 58.6% 的准确率，而开源模型与闭源商业模型之间 34.9 个百分点的差距突显了在复杂图表和表格理解方面仍有巨大的提升空间。我们开源了我们的数据集和代码。
tldr: 本文推出了HakushoBench，一个基于日本政府白皮书构建的日语图表/表格视觉问答基准，包含2,053张图像及人工标注问答对，实验表明其对现有开源视觉语言模型极具挑战性。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于巧妙利用了公开、规范且领域广泛的政府白皮书作为高质量非英语多模态数据的来源，有效解决了非英语图表数据收集难的问题。其重要性在于填补了非英语（特别是日语）多模态图表与表格理解基准的空白，有助于推动多语言视觉语言模型（VLM）的均衡发展。局限性在于目前仅针对日语进行了构建，未来在其他非英语语言上的泛化和扩展效果仍有待验证。
motivation: 理解图表和表格图像对多模态大模型的实际应用至关重要。然而，现有的图表VQA基准大多基于英文，非英文基准非常稀缺，且由于难以大规模收集真实且多样化的非英文图表图像，限制了模型在多语言环境下的泛化性评估。
method: 通过利用日本政府白皮书作为可扩展的数据源，构建了HakushoBench基准。该数据集包含来自33份白皮书的2,053张图像（涵盖10多种图表/表格类型），并人工标注了旨在评估深度和整体理解能力的问答对。最后在多种开源和闭源视觉语言模型（VLM）上进行了基准测试。
results: 实验表明，HakushoBench对目前的开源模型极具挑战性：表现最好的开源模型仅取得了58.6%的准确率，且开源模型与闭源商业模型之间存在高达34.9个百分点的性能差距，表明开源模型在复杂图表和表格理解上仍有巨大提升空间。
conclusion: HakushoBench为评估非英语图表和表格理解能力提供了一个高质量且极具挑战性的基准，实验结果表明开源模型在处理复杂图表时与闭源商业模型仍存在巨大差距，具有广阔的提升空间。

title: SkillRevise: Improving LLM-Authored Agent Skills via Trace-Conditioned Skill Revision
authors: Yuxuan Liu, Zhaochen Su, Lingyun Xie, Yuhao Zhang, Qing Zong, Jiahe Guo, Zhongwei Xie, Yiyan Ji, Yauwai Yim, Hongyu Luo, Xiyu Ren, Ruan Chenyu, Haoran Li, Yangqiu Song
abstract: Agent skills are procedural artifacts that enable LLM agents to execute workflows, verify constraints, and recover from failures. Existing self-evolving methods refine skills using accumulated trajectories. However, they struggle in cold-start settings, where only an initial, imperfect skill is available. Consequently, skill construction defaults to expert authoring or one-shot LLM generation. Expert-authored skills are costly and may not align with how LLM agents actually execute tasks, while one-shot generated skills can be syntactically well formed yet behaviorally weak. To bridge this gap, we propose SkillRevise, an execution-grounded framework designed to iteratively refine these initial skills. SkillRevise diagnoses skill defects from execution evidence, retrieves relevant repair principles from a general memory, and applies execution-anchored edits. By re-executing candidates and measuring empirical utility, it systematically retains the optimal skill version. Evaluated across three benchmarks and five LLMs, SkillRevise substantially outperforms one-shot baselines, improving the base agent's success rate on SkillsBench from 36.05% to 61.63%. Furthermore, the revised skills exhibit strong cross-model transferability, capturing generalized procedural knowledge over model-specific artifacts.
zh_title: SkillRevise：通过基于轨迹调节的技能修正提升大语言模型编写的智能体技能
translation: 智能体技能是使大语言模型（LLM）智能体能够执行工作流、验证约束并从失败中恢复的程序性伪影。现有的自我进化方法利用积累的轨迹来精炼技能。然而，它们在冷启动设置中举步维艰，即仅有一个初始且不完美的技能可用。因此，技能构建默认采用专家撰写或单次LLM生成。专家撰写的技能成本高昂，且可能与LLM智能体实际执行任务的方式不一致，而单次生成的技能虽然在语法上格式良好，但在行为上却很弱。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了SkillRevise，这是一个基于执行的框架，旨在迭代精炼这些初始技能。SkillRevise从执行证据中诊断技能缺陷，从通用记忆中检索相关的修复原则，并应用以执行为锚点的编辑。通过重新执行候选方案并衡量经验效用，它系统地保留了最佳技能版本。在三个基准和五个LLM上进行的评估表明，SkillRevise显著优于单次基线，将SkillsBench上基础智能体的成功率从36.05%提高到61.63%。此外，修改后的技能表现出强大的跨模型迁移能力，捕获了超越模型特定伪影的通用程序性知识。
tldr: 本文提出SkillRevise框架，通过执行证据诊断缺陷、检索修复原则并进行编辑，迭代优化LLM生成的初始技能，显著提升了智能体成功率并实现了强跨模型迁移。
ai_comments: 该论文切中了大语言模型智能体在冷启动阶段技能构建的痛点。现有的自我进化方法依赖大量轨迹，而本文提出的SkillRevise通过“执行-诊断-修复-验证”的迭代闭环，有效解决了单次生成技能“格式好但行为弱”的问题。其不仅在多个基准上取得了显著的性能提升，还证明了修改后的技能具有强大的跨模型迁移能力，这表明该方法能够捕获通用的程序性知识，具有很强的实用价值和启发性。
motivation: 在冷启动设置下（仅有初始且不完美的技能），现有的自进化技能精炼方法难以奏效。这导致技能构建不得不依赖高成本且可能与模型实际执行不一致的“专家撰写”，或者依赖虽然语法正确但行为能力较弱的“单次LLM生成”。论文旨在弥补这一差距，实现对初始技能的自动化迭代精炼。
method: 提出SkillRevise框架，这是一个基于执行的迭代精炼框架。其具体步骤包括：1）从执行证据中诊断技能缺陷；2）从通用记忆中检索相关的修复原则；3）应用以执行为锚点的编辑；4）通过重新执行候选技能并测量其经验效用，系统地保留最优技能版本。
results: 在三个基准和五个LLM上的评估结果表明，SkillRevise显著优于单次生成基线，将SkillsBench上基础智能体的成功率从36.05%大幅提升至61.63%。此外，修改后的技能表现出强大的跨模型迁移能力，成功捕获了通用的程序性知识。
conclusion: SkillRevise能够系统、迭代地优化LLM生成的初始技能，显著提升智能体的任务执行成功率。修改后的技能不仅在原模型上表现优异，还展现出强大的跨模型迁移能力，捕获了通用的程序性知识。

title: From Outliers to Errors: Auditing Pali-to-English LLM Translations with Multi-Reference Adjudication
authors: Máté Metzger, Nadnapang Phophichit, Hansa Dhammahaso
abstract: Single-score translation metrics can conflate legitimate variation with error, a problem especially acute for classical languages where multiple defensible English renderings of the same passage coexist. We audit Pali-to-English output from four flagship large language models (LLMs): GPT-5.5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and Grok 4.3, on 1,700 passages from the Pali Canon, using three established human translations by Bhikkhu Sujato, Thanissaro Bhikkhu, and Bhikkhu Bodhi as a local reference envelope rather than a single gold standard. Each candidate's normalized embedding drift from the reference centroid serves as a triage signal, not an error label; the 1,203 candidates above a 1.5 drift threshold are then adjudicated by a blinded three-model LLM judge panel, calibrated against a 300-instance author-adjudicated validation set. Two results stand out. First, drift predicts severity rather than error per se: the major-error rate among adjudicated high-drift candidates rose monotonically from 7.9% in the 1.5-2.0 band to 51.6% above 3.0, while approximately 80% of 1.5-2.0 outliers were judged valid translation variations. Second, model differences were clearest in the high-drift tail: GPT-5.5 had the lowest adjudicated high-drift major-error rate, with confidence intervals overlapping those of Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Gemini 3.1 Pro; Grok 4.3 had both the largest outlier volume and the highest tail major-error rate (27.6% overall, 74.4% above drift 3.0). The dominant major-error categories (e.g. omission or truncation, doctrinal term errors) are precisely the failures most likely to mislead readers of doctrinal text. The contribution is a reusable audit design for classical-to-modern translation: define a local reference envelope from multiple human translators, use embedding drift to prioritize review, and adjudicate the flagged tail rather than treating outlier status as error.
comment: Preprint. This manuscript has not yet been peer reviewed
zh_title: 从离群值到错误：使用多参考判定审计巴利语到英语的大语言模型翻译
translation: 单一得分的翻译指标容易将合理的变体与错误混淆，这一问题在古典语言中尤为严重，因为同一段落往往并存多种说得通的英文译文。我们审计了四个旗舰大语言模型（GPT-5.5、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 3.1 Pro 和 Grok 4.3）在巴利三藏 1,700 个段落上的巴利语到英语输出。我们使用 Bhikkhu Sujato、Thanissaro Bhikkhu 和 Bhikkhu Bodhi 的三部既有的人工译本作为局部参考范围，而非单一的金标准。每个候选译文与参考质心的归一化嵌入漂移作为筛选信号，而非错误标签；随后，由一个双盲的三模型大语言模型裁判小组（针对 300 个实例的作者裁决验证集进行了校准）对漂移阈值超过 1.5 的 1,203 个候选译文进行了裁决。两个结果尤为突出。首先，漂移预测的是严重程度而非错误本身：在被裁决的高漂移候选译文中，主要错误率从 1.5-2.0 区间的 7.9% 单调上升到 3.0 以上的 51.6%，而 1.5-2.0 区间的离群值中约有 80% 被判定为有效的翻译变体。其次，模型差异在高漂移尾部最为明显：GPT-5.5 的被裁决高漂移主要错误率最低，其置信区间与 Claude Sonnet 4.6 和 Gemini 3.1 Pro 重叠；Grok 4.3 的离群值数量最多，且尾部主要错误率最高（整体为 27.6%，在 3.0 漂移以上为 74.4%）。主要错误类别（例如遗漏或截断、教义术语错误）恰恰是最容易误导教义文本读者的失败。本研究的贡献在于为古典到现代语言的翻译提供了一种可复用的审计设计：从多个译者中定义局部参考范围，使用嵌入漂移来确定审查的优先级，并对标记的尾部进行裁决，而不是将离群状态直接视为错误。
tldr: 本文提出了一种利用多个人工参考译本构建评估范围、通过嵌入漂移筛选并用LLM裁判裁决的框架，成功审计了GPT-5.5等大模型在巴利语翻译上的表现，发现该方法能有效区分合理的翻译变体与严重错误。
ai_comments:
1. 创新性地引入了“多参考范围（reference envelope）”的概念，有效解决了古典文本翻译中“多重合理译本共存”对传统单一黄金标准评估带来的挑战。
2. 巧妙地将嵌入漂移（embedding drift）作为初筛信号（triage signal），而非直接判定为错误，并结合LLM多模型裁判进行二阶段精细裁决，设计非常合理且具有高可复用性。
3. 评估了包含GPT-5.5、Claude 4.6等前沿大模型在极具挑战性的巴利三藏文本上的表现，对古典语言NLP和机器翻译评估领域有重要参考价值。
4. 局限性在于，尽管LLM裁判经过了校准，但在面对极度深奥的佛教教义和哲学概念时，LLM裁判本身是否完全可靠仍有待进一步的人工双盲验证。
motivation: 单指标翻译评估方法容易将合理的翻译变体与真正的翻译错误混淆，这在古典语言（如巴利语）中尤为严重，因为同一段落往往存在多种完全合理且能自圆其说的英文译法。传统的单一黄金标准评估法无法满足这种多译本共存的评估需求。
method:
1. 收集四个旗舰大模型（GPT-5.5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Grok 4.3）对巴利三藏1,700个段落的英文翻译。
2. 以三位著名学者（Bhikkhu Sujato, Thanissaro Bhikkhu, Bhikkhu Bodhi）的人工译本构建多参考范围。
3. 计算候选译文与参考质心的归一化嵌入漂移（embedding drift）作为筛选信号，将漂移超过1.5阈值的1,203个候选译文提取出来。
4. 使用经过300个实例校准的双盲三模型LLM裁判小组，对这些高漂移候选译文进行最终裁决。
results:
1. 嵌入漂移能有效预测错误的严重程度而非错误本身：在1.5-2.0漂移区间内，约80%的离群值被判定为合理的翻译变体，主要错误率仅为7.9%；而在3.0以上区间，严重错误率升至51.6%。
2. 模型表现差异在尾部（高漂移区）最明显：GPT-5.5的严重错误率最低；而Grok 4.3产生的离群值最多，且尾部严重错误率最高（整体27.6%，3.0以上高达74.4%）。
3. 发现的主要严重错误类别（如遗漏、截断和教义术语错误）极易误导读者。
conclusion: 本文提出了一种适用于古典到现代语言翻译的可复用审计框架：通过多个优秀人类译本构建局部参考范围，利用嵌入漂移筛选出疑似离群的翻译，并对这部分尾部数据进行多模型裁决，从而避免了将合理的翻译变体误判为错误。

title: Repeated Descent: A Framework for Online Budget-Feasible Auctions
authors: Andreas Charalampopoulos, Dimitris Fotakis, Thanos Tolias
abstract:
We study budget feasible procurement auctions, in which $n$ agents, each with a privately held service cost, offer their services to an employer. The employer seeks to maximize a public submodular valuation function over the set of hired agents, while facing a hard budget constraint. We consider an online posted-price setting, in which agents arrive in a uniformly random order (a.k.a. \emph{secretary arrivals}) and the employer must make irrevocable take-it-or-leave-it offers upon their arrival. The employer does not get any feedback about the agent service costs other than whether they accept the offer or not.
  We introduce Repeated Descent (a.k.a. \RED), a deterministic framework based on adaptive linear posted pricing. \RED enforces budget feasibility by adaptively adjusting its pricing and balancing each pricing level with the number of agents considered in it. Using \RED as the main building block, we obtain a $1046$-competitive posted-price mechanism for online budget feasible auctions with secretary agent arrivals and submodular valuations, thus improving on the previously best known ratio of (Charalampopoulos et al., EC 2025) by several orders of magnitude. Combining \RED with random subsampling, we obtain the first constant-competitive posted-price budget feasible mechanism for non-monotone submodular valuations. On the negative side, we show that every online budget feasible mechanism with XOS valuations has a competitive ratio of $Ω\!\left(\tfrac{\log n}{(\log\log n)^2}\right)$.
zh_title: 重复下降：在线预算可行拍卖的框架
translation: 我们研究了预算可行的采购拍卖，其中 $n$ 个代理人（每个代理人都有私有的服务成本）向雇主提供服务。雇主寻求在面临硬性预算约束的情况下，最大化已雇用代理人集合上的公共子模估值函数。我们考虑在线明码标价设置，其中代理人以均匀随机的顺序（即秘书到达）到来，雇主必须在他们到来时做出不可撤销的、要么接受要么放弃的报价。除了代理人是否接受报价之外，雇主不会得到任何关于代理人服务成本的反馈。我们引入了“重复下降”（简称为 RED），这是一个基于自适应线性明码标价的确定性框架。RED 通过自适应地调整其定价，并平衡每个定价水平与其中考虑的代理人数量，从而强制实现预算可行性。以 RED 作为主要构建模块，我们针对具有秘书代理人到达和子模估值的在线预算可行拍卖，获得了一个 1046-竞争的明码标价机制，从而将先前已知的最佳比率（Charalampopoulos 等人，EC 2025）提高了几个数量级。通过将 RED 与随机子抽样相结合，我们获得了针对非单调子模估值的第一个常数竞争的明码标价预算可行机制。在负面结果方面，我们表明，对于 XOS 估值，每个在线预算可行机制的竞争比至少为 $\Omega\left(\frac{\log n}{(\log\log n)^2}\right)$。
tldr: 本文提出了RED自适应定价框架，将在线预算可行拍卖（子模估值）的竞争比显著降低至1046，并首次实现了非单调子模估值下的常数竞争机制。
ai_comments: 该论文的主要创新点在于提出了RED（Repeated Descent）自适应定价框架，成功将在线预算可行拍卖中子模估值下的竞争比降低了数个数量级（达到1046，虽然绝对值仍较大，但理论上是一次巨大飞跃）。此外，该框架具有良好的推广性，结合随机子抽样首次解决了非单调子模估值的常数竞争比问题，并给出了XOS估值下的硬性理论下界，研究非常完整且具有重要的学术价值。
motivation: 在在线预算可行采购拍卖中，雇主需要在硬性预算约束下最大化子模估值，且代理人以随机顺序（秘书到达）到来。由于雇主只能进行不可撤销的明码标价报价，且无法获得除接受/拒绝之外的成本反馈，现有的机制竞争比较差。因此，需要设计一种更高效的在线预算可行定价机制。
method: 引入了名为“重复下降”（Repeated Descent，简称RED）的确定性框架，该框架基于自适应线性明码标价（adaptive linear posted pricing）。RED通过自适应地调整定价，并平衡每个定价水平与该水平下考虑的代理人数量，从而强制实现预算可行性。此外，还将RED与随机子抽样（random subsampling）相结合。
results:
1. 基于RED框架，针对秘书到达和子模估值的在线预算可行拍卖，获得了一个1046-竞争的明码标价机制，比前人最好结果提高了数个数量级。
2. 首次为非单调子模估值设计出了常数竞争的明码标价预算可行机制。
3. 证明了对于XOS估值，任何在线预算可行机制的竞争比下界为 $\Omega\left(\frac{\log n}{(\log\log n)^2}\right)$。
conclusion: 本文证明了通过自适应线性明码标价框架（RED），可以极大地优化在线预算可行拍卖在子模估值下的竞争比，并首次实现了非单调子模估值下的常数竞争比。同时，XOS估值下的下界分析明确了该问题的理论极限。

title: AMP: A Vendor-Neutral Wire Format for Agent Memory Operations
authors: Thamilvendhan Munirathinam
abstract: Agent-memory frameworks - mem0, Letta/MemGPT, Cognee, Zep/Graphiti, MemoryOS, MemTensor - each ship their own SDK, storage layout, and operational vocabulary. There is no shared wire format: every integration is bespoke, every migration rebuilds memory from scratch, and no framework ships a governance surface that lets a human review writes before they enter long-term storage. We present memorywire, a JSON-Schema 2020-12 wire format for five memory operations (remember, recall, forget, merge, expire) over four memory types (semantic, episodic, procedural, emotional), with a MemoryStore interface, a fan-out router, and an optional HITL governance channel. We describe an open-source reference implementation with five backend adapters (sqlite-vec, mem0, Letta, Cognee, pgvector); a microbenchmark on a 100-fact / 50-query labelled corpus achieving recall@5 = 1.000 on the 42 labelled queries with ingest p50 = 37.8 ms and recall p50 = 40.6 ms; an adversarial-fusion experiment showing Reciprocal Rank Fusion holds recall@5 = 1.000 across a 1-of-N rank-0 injection sweep (K in {0,5,...,50}) where max fusion collapses to 0.500 with 80% leak at K >= 5; and a 16-scenario cross-adapter conformance suite passing 68 of 80 cells with zero failures. The contribution is not a new algorithm; it is a packaging of established components (RRF, FSMs, STM/LTM consolidation, diff-and-approve workflows) into a venue-neutral protocol with an empirically validated reference, positioned to compose with the Model Context Protocol rather than compete with it.
comment: 17 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Reference implementation with 5 backend adapters (sqlite-vec, mem0, Letta, Cognee, pgvector), governance UI, microbench, adversarial-fusion experiment, 16-scenario conformance suite, threat model, and preliminary LongMemEval + LoCoMo numbers. Code at https://github.com/mthamil107/memorywire. Companion to arXiv:2604.18248 (Prompt Injection Detection)
zh_title: AMP：一种用于智能体内存操作的厂商中立线格式
translation: 智能体内存框架——mem0、Letta/MemGPT、Cognee、Zep/Graphiti、MemoryOS、MemTensor——各自配备了专属的 SDK、存储布局和操作词汇。目前缺乏共享的线格式（wire format）：每次集成都是定制的，每次迁移都需要从头重建内存，且没有一个框架提供能让渡人类在写入数据进入长期存储前进行审查的治理界面。我们提出了 `memorywire`，这是一种基于 JSON-Schema 2020-12 的线格式，针对四种内存类型（语义、情景、程序、情感）支持五种内存操作（记住、召回、忘记、合并、过期），并配备了 MemoryStore 接口、扇出路由器和可选的 HITL（人机协同）治理通道。我们描述了一个开源参考实现，其中包含五个后端适配器（sqlite-vec、mem0、Letta、Cognee、pgvector）；在包含 100 个事实/50 个查询的标注语料库上进行的微基准测试中，在 42 个标注查询上实现了 recall@5 = 1.000，其中摄取 p50 为 37.8 ms，召回 p50 为 40.6 ms；一项对抗性融合实验表明，在 1-of-N rank-0 注入扫频（K 属于 {0,5,...,50}）中，倒数排名融合（RRF）保持 recall@5 = 1.000，而最大融合在 K >= 5 时崩溃至 0.500 且有 80% 的泄露；以及一个 16 场景的跨适配器一致性套件，在 80 个单元格中通过了 68 个，零失败。本研究的贡献并非一种新算法，而是将已有的组件（RRF、有限状态机、短期/长期内存整合、差异与批准工作流）打包成一个与平台无关的协议，并配有经过实证验证的参考实现，旨在与模型上下文协议（MCP）协同工作，而非竞争。
tldr: 本文提出了 AMP（memorywire），一种厂商中立的智能体内存操作 JSON-Schema 线格式，支持 5 种操作和 4 种内存类型，并提供了多后端支持的开源参考实现与验证。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于并非发明新算法，而是首次在智能体内存领域提出了一个厂商中立的标准化协议（AMP/memorywire），解决了不同内存框架（如 mem0、MemGPT 等）互不兼容、难以迁移的痛点。其引入的人机协同（HITL）治理通道对于需要高可靠性、数据合规性的企业级应用非常有价值。此外，该协议主动拥抱 Model Context Protocol（MCP）生态，定位精准，具有很强的实用推广潜力。
motivation: 当前的智能体内存框架（如 mem0、MemGPT 等）各自使用独立的 SDK、存储布局和操作词汇，缺乏共享的统一线格式（wire format）。这导致每次集成都需要定制，迁移内存时需要从头重建，且缺乏允许人类在数据存入长期存储前进行审核的治理机制。
method: 提出 `memorywire`（基于 JSON-Schema 2020-12 的线格式），定义了 5 种内存操作（记住、召回、忘记、合并、过期）和 4 种内存类型（语义、情景、程序、情感）。设计了 MemoryStore 接口、扇出路由器和可选的 HITL（人机协同）治理通道。提供了一个包含 5 个后端适配器（sqlite-vec, mem0, Letta, Cognee, pgvector）的开源参考实现。
results:
1. 在 100 个事实/50 个查询的微基准测试中，在 42 个标注查询上实现了 recall@5 = 1.000，摄取 p50 为 37.8 ms，召回 p50 为 40.6 ms。
2. 对抗融合实验表明，倒数排名融合（RRF）在注入扫频中保持了 recall@5 = 1.000，而最大融合在 K >= 5 时崩溃至 0.500。
3. 16 场景跨适配器一致性测试中，80 个单元格中通过了 68 个，且无一失败。
conclusion: 本文成功开发并验证了 AMP（memorywire），这是一个厂商中立的智能体内存操作协议。它将现有技术（如 RRF、FSMs 等）打包成一个标准化、可互操作的规范，能够与 MCP 协同工作，为智能体内存的标准化奠定了基础。

title: Schedule-Level Shared-Prefix Reuse for LLM RL Training
authors: Pengbo Li, Feiyuan Zhang, Guangming Sheng, Guangxin He, Di Chai, Ziniu Li, Taiqiang Wu, Binhang Yuan, Kai Chen
abstract: GRPO- and PPO-style LLM post-training commonly sample multiple trajectories from the same prompt and then train on the resulting group. In long-context RL workloads, this shared prompt-side prefix can contain retrieved passages, visual tokens, tool schemas, system instructions, or task context, while the full rollout group is still too large to pack into one training microbatch. Standard dense trainers therefore recompute the same prefix forward and backward for every trajectory. We present a schedule-level reuse mechanism that decouples prefix and suffix computation. The schedule runs prefix forward once, executes suffixes as ordinary microbatches while reading prefix K/V and accumulating prefix-side gK/gV , and then runs prefix backward once on the accumulated gradient cache. This reordered schedule is equivalent to baseline training over real arithmetic and aligns numerically within finite-precision tolerance. Because only K/V and gK/gV are hot during suffix computation, the approach offloads dormant prefix activations, integrates with TP/EP/CP/PP and DP-style placement at the execution level, and preserves aux-loss-based MoE router semantics through logical prefix-token accounting. On dense Llama3-8B, Qwen3-8B, and MoE Qwen3-MoE-30B-A3B configurations, the schedule matches optimizer updates across TP/CP/PP/EP combinations, aligns on a 100-step real RL trace replay, reaches up to 4.395x speedup (2.930x under a conservative compile-on comparison) as prefix ratio and rollout group size grow, and reduces Phase-B peak HBM by up to 59.1%, extending the Llama3-8B capacity frontier from 17,920 to 29,696 total tokens.
zh_title: LLM强化学习训练中的调度级共享前缀复用
translation: 基于GRPO和PPO风格的大语言模型（LLM）事后训练通常会从相同的提示词（prompt）中采样多个轨迹，然后对生成的组进行训练。在长上下文强化学习（RL）工作负载中，这种共享的提示词侧前缀可能包含检索到的段落、视觉Token、工具模式、系统指令或任务上下文，而完整的Rollout组仍然太大，无法打包进一个训练微批次中。因此，标准的密集训练器会对每个轨迹重复计算相同前缀的前向和反向传播。我们提出了一种调度级的复用机制，将前缀和后缀计算解耦。该调度运行一次前缀前向传播，将后缀作为普通的微批次执行，同时读取前缀的K/V并累积前缀侧的gK/gV，然后对累积的梯度缓存运行一次前缀反向传播。这种重新排序的调度在实数运算上等价于基线训练，并在有限精度容差内实现数值对齐。由于在后缀计算期间只有K/V和gK/gV是活跃的，该方法卸载了休眠的前缀激活值，在执行层与TP/EP/CP/PP和DP风格的部署集成，并通过逻辑前缀Token记账保留了基于辅助损失的MoE路由语义。在稠密Llama3-8B、Qwen3-8B和MoE Qwen3-MoE-30B-A3B配置上，该调度在各种TP/CP/PP/EP组合中与优化器更新相匹配，在100步真实RL轨迹重放中对齐，随着前缀比例和Rollout组大小的增加，实现了高达4.395倍的加速（在保守的编译比较下为2.930倍），并减少了高达59.1%的Phase-B峰值HBM，将Llama3-8B的容量边界从17,920个总Token扩展到29,696个。
tldr: 提出一种调度级共享前缀复用机制，通过解耦前后向计算和梯度累积，实现LLM强化学习训练高达4.395倍的加速并减少59.1%的显存占用。
ai_comments: 本论文针对当前大语言模型强化学习训练（如GRPO、PPO等需要从同一Prompt中采样多个轨迹的场景）中存在的计算冗余问题，提出了非常务实且高效的系统级优化方案。其创新之处在于在调度层面将前缀和后缀计算解耦，通过一次前导计算和梯度累积复用，既消除了重复的前后向计算，又通过激活值卸载显著降低了显存开销。该方法不仅在数学上与基线等价，还能无缝兼容TP/PP/EP/CP等复杂分布式并行策略，对长文本RL训练的工业界落地具有重要意义。
motivation: 在长上下文大语言模型（LLM）强化学习（如GRPO和PPO）训练中，通常会从同一个提示词（Prompt）中采样多个轨迹。由于完整的Rollout组太大无法放入单个微批次中，标准的密集训练器会为每个轨迹重复计算相同前缀的前向和反向传播，导致严重的计算浪费和显存压力。
method: 提出一种调度级的复用机制，解耦前缀和后缀计算。该调度仅运行一次前缀的前向传播，随后将后缀作为普通微批次执行（在此期间读取前缀的K/V并累积前缀侧的梯度gK/gV），最后在累积的梯度缓存上运行一次前缀的反向传播。同时，该方法在后缀计算期间卸载不活跃的前缀激活值，并与TP/EP/CP/PP等多种并行策略集成，保留MoE路由语义。
results: 在Llama3-8B、Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-MoE-30B-A3B配置下，该方法与基线训练数值对齐。随着前缀比例和Rollout组大小的增加，实现了高达4.395倍的加速（保守编译对比下为2.930倍），并减少了高达59.1%的Phase-B峰值HBM（显存），将Llama3-8B的容量极限从17,920个Token扩展至29,696个Token。
conclusion: 该调度级共享前缀复用机制在不损失数值精度的前提下，显著提升了LLM长上下文强化学习训练的效率并降低了显存占用，拓展了模型的训练容量边界。

title: Reasoning4Sciences: Bridging Reasoning Language Models to All Scientific Branches
authors: Teddy Ferdinan, Bartłomiej Koptyra, Mikołaj Langner, Tomasz Adamczyk, Łukasz Radliński, Maciej Markiewicz, Aleksander Szczęsny, Stanisław Woźniak, Tymoteusz Romanowicz, Dzmitry Pihulski, Mateusz Zbrocki, Mateusz Śmigielski, Michał Rajkowski, Mateusz Biedka, Konrad Kiełczyński, Konrad Wojtasik, Jacek Duszenko, Jan Eliasz, Piotr Matys, Michał Bernacki-Janson, Maria Bellaniar Ismiati, Latius Hermawan, Wiktoria Mieleszczenko-Kowszewicz, Anna Kubicka-Sowinska, Grzegorz Chodak, Karol Postawa, Paweł Zyblewski, Tomasz Szandała, Łukasz Sterczewski, Adrian Chajec, Pawel Niewiadomski, Piotr Gruber, Marcin Wdowikowski, Sławomir Czarnecki, Bartłomiej Kryszak, Dominik Drabik, Tomasz Kajdanowicz, Kamil Mamak, Paweł Preś, Katarzyna Paczkowska, Joachim Sobczuk, Tomasz Zięba, Jan Kocoń, Maciej Piasecki, Przemysław Kazienko
abstract: While Reasoning Language Models (RLMs) are rapidly emerging as powerful tools for scientific research, their impact is primarily concentrated in "hard science" fields. The slow -- or lack of -- adoption of RLMs in other branches of science is causing a widening gap in research productivity. In this survey, we provide the first comprehensive analysis of RLM adoption across 28 scientific disciplines following the classification used by the European Research Council (ERC), spanning the Social Sciences and Humanities, Physical Sciences and Engineering, and Life Sciences. We examine how RLMs are developed, evaluated, and applied across disciplines. Furthermore, we introduce a maturity-oriented assessment framework based on available domain-specific development and evaluation resources, revealing substantial disparities in RLM maturity that become even more pronounced when only publicly available resources are considered. Finally, we highlight current implementation paradigms that are gaining popularity across disciplines, current challenges, and future directions in enabling RLM adoption across science.
zh_title: Reasoning4Sciences：将推理语言模型桥接到所有科学分支
translation: 尽管推理语言模型（RLM）正迅速成为科学研究的强大工具，但它们的影响主要集中在“硬科学”领域。在其他科学分支中，RLM的采用缓慢或缺乏，导致研究生产力差距不断扩大。在这项综述中，我们首次对28个科学学科（遵循欧洲研究委员会ERC的分类，涵盖社会科学与人文科学、物理科学与工程、生命科学）的RLM采用情况进行了全面分析。我们研究了RLM在不同学科中的开发、评估和应用方式。此外，我们引入了一个基于可用领域特定开发和评估资源的成熟度导向评估框架，揭示了RLM成熟度方面存在的实质性差距，当仅考虑公开可用的资源时，这种差距变得更加明显。最后，我们强调了目前在各学科中逐渐流行的实现范式、面临的挑战以及在全科学领域推动RLM采用的未来方向。
tldr: 本文是首篇全面分析推理语言模型（RLM）在28个科学学科中采用现状的综述，提出了一个成熟度评估框架，揭示了学科间RLM应用成熟度的巨大差距，并探讨了未来的推广方向。
ai_comments: 本综述具有很高的时效性和现实意义。其创新之处在于首次系统地将推理语言模型（RLM）的应用评估扩展到欧洲研究委员会（ERC）定义的28个细分学科，并提出了一个新颖的成熟度评估框架，定量地揭示了不同学科之间在AI应用上的鸿沟。局限性在于，作为一篇综述，它主要侧重于现状梳理和框架构建，并未直接提供解决这些跨学科成熟度差距的具体算法或模型。
motivation: 推理语言模型（RLM）已成为科学研究的强大工具，但其应用目前主要集中在“硬科学”领域。在其他科学分支中，RLM的采用进展缓慢甚至缺失，导致不同学科之间的研究生产力差距不断拉大。
method: 本文是一项系统性综述。作者遵循欧洲研究委员会（ERC）的分类方法，对涵盖社会科学与人文科学、物理科学与工程、生命科学在内的28个科学学科的RLM采用情况进行了全面分析；同时，引入了一个基于特定领域开发和评估资源的成熟度导向评估框架，并总结了当前的实现范式、挑战和未来方向。
results: 研究揭示了不同学科在RLM成熟度方面存在显著差异，且在仅考虑公开可用资源时，这种不平衡性更加突出。此外，文章总结了目前在各学科中逐渐流行的实现范式，并明确了推广RLM所面临的挑战。
conclusion: 本文梳理了当前跨学科推广RLM的实现范式、面临的挑战和未来方向，旨在为弥合不同学科间的科研生产力差距、推动RLM在全科学领域的均衡发展提供指引。

title: On Fréchet Traveling Salesmen Problems
authors: Omrit Filtser, Tzalik Maimon, Michal Moiseev
abstract: The Fréchet distance is a well-studied distance measure between two curves. In this work, we demonstrate that the merit of Fréchet distance extends beyond evaluating similarity, and introduce a new setting in which it proves useful. Consider a situation where two agents are required to visit a given set of sites, while staying close to each other throughout their traversal. In this paper, we study problems where the goal is to construct two curves whose vertices are from a given set of points, under the constraint that the Fréchet distance between the curves is kept as small as possible. This problem can be viewed as a variant of the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP), and thus may be of interest in routing, network planning and more. We present a near-linear algorithm for this problem under the discrete Fréchet distance, and explore several variants of the problem, including minimizing the lengths of the curves and balancing the number of sites assigned to each agent. Lastly, we prove that the problem is NP-hard under the continuous Fréchet Distance.
zh_title: 关于Fréchet旅行商问题的研究
translation: Fréchet距离是两条曲线之间一种经过深入研究的距离度量。在这项工作中，我们证明了Fréchet距离的价值不仅限于评估相似性，并引入了一种它能发挥作用的新场景。考虑这样一种情况：两个代理需要访问一组给定的站点，同时在整个遍历过程中保持彼此靠近。在本文中，我们研究了这样一些问题，其目标是构建两条顶点来自给定点集的曲线，并限制两条曲线之间的Fréchet距离尽可能小。这个问题可以被视为旅行商问题（TSP）的一种变体，因此在路由、网络规划等方面可能具有应用价值。我们针对离散Fréchet距离提出了该问题的一个近线性算法，并探讨了该问题的几种变体，包括最小化曲线长度以及平衡分配给每个代理的站点数量。最后，我们证明了该问题在连续Fréchet距离下是NP难的。
tldr: 本文研究了Fréchet旅行商问题（双代理在保持Fréchet距离最小的前提下访问点集），提出了离散距离下的近线性算法，并证明了连续距离下该问题是NP难的。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地将Fréchet距离引入到旅行商问题（TSP）中，提出了Fréchet TSP这一新概念，在多智能体协同路径规划和网络规划中具有很高的应用价值。研究不仅给出了高效的离散版本算法，还对连续版本进行了计算复杂度分析，理论完备性较强。
motivation: 在需要两个代理访问给定点集且在遍历过程中保持彼此接近的实际场景下，探索如何构建两条顶点来自该点集且它们之间的Fréchet距离尽可能小的路径。
method: 针对离散Fréchet距离设计了近线性算法；探讨了最小化曲线长度和平衡各代理站点数等变体；并对连续Fréchet距离下的问题进行了硬度证明。
results: 提出了离散Fréchet距离下的近线性求解算法，并证明了在连续Fréchet距离下该问题是NP难的。
conclusion: Fréchet距离的应用不仅限于评估相似性，还可以有效应用于多智能体协同路径规划（如TSP变体）中，但其计算复杂度依离散与连续定义的不同而有显著差异（离散下可近线性求解，连续下为NP难）。

title: Not All Explanations Simulate Equally: Comparing Verbalized Feature Attributions and Self-Generated Rationales
authors: Pingjun Hong, Benjamin Roth
abstract: Natural-language explanations are often treated as a unified interface for understanding model behavior, but different explanation sources may support simulation in different ways. This paper compares two families of explanations for question answering models: verbalized feature attributions and self-generated rationales. We evaluate them under a shared counterfactual simulation setting, using an LLM judge as predictor and measuring whether it can better predict a model's answers to follow-up questions when given its explanation. Across multiple instruction-tuned models, we analyze how explanation source, verbalization strategy, and feature granularity affect the simulatability of explanations. Our results show that explanation format and granularity affect simulatability: attribution-based explanations and self-generated rationales differ in how much they improve counterfactual prediction, with effects that vary across models and formats.
zh_title: 并非所有解释的可模拟性都相同：对比语言化的特征归因与自生成合理化
translation: 自然语言解释通常被视为理解模型行为的统一接口，但不同的解释来源可能会以不同的方式支持模拟。本文比较了问答模型的两类解释：语言化特征归因和自生成合理化。我们在一个共享的反事实模拟设置下对它们进行评估，使用大语言模型（LLM）裁判作为预测器，并衡量在给定解释时，它是否能够更好地预测模型对后续问题的回答。在多个指令微调模型中，我们分析了解释来源、语言化策略和特征粒度如何影响解释的可模拟性。我们的结果表明，解释格式和粒度会影响可模拟性：基于归因的解释和自生成的合理化在改善反事实预测方面的效果有所不同，其效果因模型和格式而异。
tldr: 本文对比了语言化特征归因和自生成合理化两类解释，发现它们在反事实模拟中的表现存在差异，且可模拟性受解释格式、粒度和模型类型的显著影响。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新之处在于提出了一个统一的反事实模拟框架，用来定量比较“语言化特征归因”和“自生成合理化”这两类截然不同的解释方法。这有助于打破过去对自然语言解释“一刀切”的认知。其局限性在于，评估高度依赖于LLM裁判的预测能力，且实验主要集中在问答任务上，其结论在其他复杂任务或多模态场景下的泛化性仍有待验证。
motivation: 虽然自然语言解释常被视为理解模型行为的通用接口，但不同来源的解释支持“模拟”（即预测模型行为）的方式可能存在差异。因此，需要系统地比较不同解释类型在模拟模型行为方面的表现。
method: 在共享的反事实模拟设置下，对比评估了问答模型的两类解释（语言化特征归因和自生成合理化）。使用LLM作为裁判（预测器），衡量在提供解释的情况下，它能否更准确地预测模型对后续问题的回答，并分析了解释来源、语言化策略和特征粒度对可模拟性的影响。
results: 解释的格式和粒度显著影响其可模拟性。基于特征归因的解释与自生成的合理化在改善反事实预测方面的效果存在差异，且这种效果因模型和具体格式的不同而有所不同。
conclusion: 并非所有自然语言解释在支持模型模拟方面的效果都是等同的。解释的格式、特征粒度以及所使用的模型类型，共同决定了其在反事实预测中的有效性。

title: CoSTL: Comprehensive Spatial-Temporal Representation Learning for Moment Retrieval and Highlight Detection
authors: Xin Dong, Wenjia Geng, Wenfeng Deng, Yansong Tang
abstract: Video Moment Retrieval (MR) and Highlight Detection (HD) are crucial tasks in video analysis that aim to localize specific moments and estimate clip-wise relevance based on a given text query. Recent approaches treat them as similar video grounding tasks and use the same architecture to solve them. These tasks require both fine-grained comprehension at the image level and high-level temporal understanding across the entire video. Existing approaches have primarily focused on temporal modeling using frame-level features, often neglecting the rich visual information related to the text query within individual frames. This oversight leads to inaccurate grounding results. To address this limitation, we propose a Comprehensive Spatial-Temporal Representation Learning Framework (CoSTL), which captures both fine-grained image-level information and temporal dynamics. Specifically, CoSTL incorporates a text-driven progressive fine-grained image encoder, performing a two-step text-driven knowledge extraction process to learn fine-grained spatial representations. Furthermore, a multi-scale temporal perception module captures comprehensive spatial-temporal representations, enhancing the model's ability to process temporal dynamics. We demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on four public benchmarks: QVHighlights, Charades-STA, TACoS, and TVSum.
zh_title: CoSTL: 针对时刻检索和高光检测的全面时空表征学习
translation: 视频时刻检索（MR）和高光检测（HD）是视频分析中的关键任务，旨在根据给定的文本查询定位特定时刻并估计片段关联度。最近的方法将它们视为相似的视频定位任务，并使用相同的架构来解决它们。这些任务既需要图像层面的细粒度理解，也需要整个视频的高层时间理解。现有方法主要专注于使用帧级特征进行时间建模，往往忽略了单个帧内与文本查询相关的丰富视觉信息。这种疏忽导致了不准确的定位结果。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种全面的时空表征学习框架（CoSTL），该框架同时捕获了细粒度的图像级信息和时间动态。具体而言，CoSTL结合了一个文本驱动的渐进式细粒度图像编码器，执行两步文本驱动的知识提取过程以学习细粒度空间表征。此外，一个多尺度时间感知模块捕获了全面的时空表征，增强了模型处理时间动态的能力。我们在四个公开基准数据集（QVHighlights、Charades-STA、TACoS和TVSum）上展示了最先进的性能。
tldr: 本文提出了CoSTL框架，通过文本驱动的渐进式图像编码器和多尺度时间感知模块，同时捕获帧内细粒度空间信息和跨帧时间动态，在视频时刻检索和高光检测任务中取得了最先进的性能。
ai_comments: 该论文创新地将细粒度图像级空间信息与宏观时间建模结合，解决了以往方法只关注帧级时间特征而忽略帧内文本相关视觉细节的痛点。提出的两步文本驱动知识提取设计非常新颖，在多个主流数据集（QVHighlights, Charades-STA, TACoS, TVSum）上的优异表现也证明了该方法的有效性和泛化能力。
motivation: 现有的视频时刻检索和高光检测方法主要专注于使用帧级特征进行时间建模，往往忽略了单个帧内与文本查询相关的丰富细粒度视觉信息，从而导致定位结果不准确。
method:
提出了一种全面的时空表征学习框架（CoSTL）。该框架包含两个核心部分：
1. 文本驱动的渐进式细粒度图像编码器：通过执行两步文本驱动的知识提取过程来学习细粒度的空间表征。
2. 多尺度时间感知模块：用于捕获全面的时空表征，增强模型处理时间动态的能力。
results: 在四个公开基准数据集（QVHighlights、Charades-STA、TACoS 和 TVSum）上均取得了最先进的（SOTA）性能。
conclusion: CoSTL框架通过有效融合细粒度图像级空间信息与多尺度时间动态，显著提升了视频时刻检索和高光检测的性能，证明了同时建模细粒度空间和时间维度的重要性。

title: Lagrangian Perturbation Diffusion Steering: Latent Reinforcement Learning for Generative Policies
authors: Hikmet Simsir, Ozgur S. Oguz
abstract: Behavior cloning with high-capacity generative policies achieves strong imitation performance, but is often limited by demonstration coverage and distribution shift. Direct reinforcement learning fine-tuning can improve performance, but updating large action decoders is frequently unstable and sample inefficient. We propose Lagrangian Perturbation Diffusion Steering (LP-DS), a lightweight adaptation method that improves a frozen generative policy by learning a compact noise-space perturbation before decoding. LP-DS optimizes this perturbation with a Lagrangian trust-region objective, improving downstream value while constraining deviation from the latent prior. Across RoboMimic manipulation, OpenAI Gym locomotion, and Adroit dexterous manipulation benchmarks, LP-DS improves sample efficiency, success, and return while maintaining higher action-space entropy than unconstrained noise-space steering, with return improvements of up to 25% over prior baselines. Additional evaluations with flow-matching backbones, a large vision-language-action model, and physical Franka deployment show that LP-DS is not limited to compact diffusion policies or simulated benchmarks. Project page: https://sites.google.com/view/lp-ds/home.
comment: Accepted as a regular paper at ICML 2026
zh_title: 拉格朗日扰动扩散引导：生成式策略的潜空间强化学习
translation: 使用高容量生成式策略的行为克隆取得了强大的模仿性能，但通常受到演示覆盖范围和分布偏移的限制。直接进行强化学习微调可以提高性能，但更新大型动作解码器通常不稳定且样本效率低下。我们提出了拉格朗日扰动扩散引导（LP-DS），这是一种轻量级的自适应方法，通过在解码前学习一个紧凑的噪声空间扰动来改进冻结的生成式策略。LP-DS使用拉格朗日信任区域目标来优化此扰动，在约束其偏离潜空间先验的同时提高下游价值。在RoboMimic操作、OpenAI Gym运动和Adroit灵巧操作基准测试中，LP-DS提高了样本效率、成功率和回报，同时保持了比无约束噪声空间引导更高的动作空间熵，其回报相比先前的基准提高了多达25%。在流匹配骨干、大型视觉-语言-动作模型和物理Franka机器人部署上的额外评估表明，LP-DS不仅限于紧凑的扩散策略或模拟基准。项目页面：https://sites.google.com/view/lp-ds/home。
tldr: 提出LP-DS方法，通过在冻结的生成式策略的潜噪声空间中学习受约束的扰动，实现了高效、稳定的强化学习自适应，在多项任务中比先前基准提升了高达25%的回报。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于，它没有直接微调庞大且不稳定的动作解码器，而是将自适应过程限制在冻结生成策略的潜噪声空间中，并巧妙地引入了拉格朗日信任区域约束。这种设计不仅极大地提高了强化学习微调的样本效率和稳定性，还通过约束偏差保留了先验知识的多样性（高熵）。该方法具有很强的实用价值，特别是在大模型和物理机器人部署上展现了优秀的泛化能力。其局限性在摘要中未直接提及，但可能对预训练生成式策略的初始质量有一定依赖。
motivation: 基于行为克隆的高容量生成式策略常受限于演示覆盖不足和分布偏移。虽然直接使用强化学习进行微调可以改善性能，但更新大型动作解码器往往面临训练不稳定和样本效率低下的问题。
method: 提出拉格朗日扰动扩散引导（LP-DS）方法。该方法保持生成式策略（动作解码器）冻结，在解码前学习一个紧凑的噪声空间扰动。通过引入拉格朗日信任区域目标（Lagrangian trust-region objective）来优化该扰动，从而在提升下游任务价值的同时，限制其偏离潜空间先验。
results: 在RoboMimic操作、OpenAI Gym运动和Adroit灵巧操作基准上，LP-DS显著提升了样本效率、成功率和回报（比先前基准提高多达25%），且保持了比无约束引导更高的动作空间熵。此外，在流匹配骨干、大型视觉-语言-动作模型以及物理Franka机器人上的评估也证实了该方法的有效性和泛化性。
conclusion: LP-DS是一种高效、稳定的生成式策略自适应方法，它成功克服了传统强化学习微调大模型时的不稳定性和低样本效率问题，不仅在模拟基准上表现优异，而且能够有效扩展到流匹配骨干、大型视觉-语言-动作模型及实体机器人部署中。

title: A piecewise constant levelset approach for semi-blind deconvolution: Application to barcode decoding
authors: Adriano De Cezaro, Eduardo Hafemann, Antonio Leitão
abstract: We consider a semi-blind deconvolution problem arising in the decoding of blurred linear barcodes. Building on the Piecewise Constant Level Set (PCLS) framework introduced in [De\,Cezaro et al., Inv.\,Probl., 29 (2013), 015003], we propose and analyze a solution method based on augmented Lagrangians to obtain stable approximate solutions to the corresponding inverse problem with respect to noisy measurements. We establish the existence of generalized multipliers for the augmented Lagrangian functional under consideration, as well as the absence of duality gaps. These results provide the theoretical foundation required to prove regularization properties of the approximate solutions produced by the proposed strategy. Furthermore, we present an associated ADMM-type iterative scheme for the explicit computation of approximate barcodes. Numerical experiments are carried out for various variance values (responsible for the blurred effect) and several levels of noise, validating the effectiveness of the proposed method.
zh_title: 一种用于半盲反褶积的分段常数水平集方法：在条形码解码中的应用
translation: 我们考虑了模糊线性条形码解码中出现的半盲反褶积问题。基于 [De Cezaro et al., Inv. Probl., 29 (2013), 015003] 中引入的分段常数水平集（PCLS）框架，我们提出并分析了一种基于增广拉格朗日的方法，以针对含噪测量获得相应逆问题的稳定近似解。我们确立了所讨论的增广拉格朗日泛函的广义乘子的存在性，以及对偶间隙的缺失。这些结果为证明所提策略产生的近似解的正则化性质提供了所需的理论基础。此外，我们提出了一种相关的类ADMM迭代方案，用于显式计算近似条形码。针对不同的方差值（导致模糊效果）和几种噪声水平进行了数值实验，验证了所提方法的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于分段常数水平集和增广拉格朗日/ADMM方法的半盲反褶积算法，为模糊一维条形码解码提供了具备理论正则化保证的高效求解方案。
ai_comments: 该论文成功地将分段常数水平集（PCLS）方法与增广拉格朗日及ADMM算法相结合，解决了条形码解码中的半盲反褶积难题。其主要贡献在于不仅提出了实用的计算方案，还给出了坚实的数学证明（如广义乘子存在性和无对偶间隙），保证了算法的理论收敛性与正则化性质。局限性在于目前主要针对一维条形码，未来可进一步探索向二维条码或更普遍图像去模糊领域的推广。
motivation: 针对模糊线性条形码解码中的半盲反褶积问题，旨在克服噪声干扰并获得相应逆问题的稳定近似解。
method: 基于分段常数水平集（PCLS）框架，提出了一种基于增广拉格朗日函数的求解方法。在理论上证明了广义乘子的存在性以及无对偶间隙，并设计了一种相关的类ADMM（交替方向乘子法）迭代方案进行显式计算。
results: 通过在多种模糊方差值和不同噪声水平下进行的数值实验，成功验证了所提算法在条形码解码重建中的有效性。
conclusion: 理论分析为所提策略产生的近似解的正则化性质提供了坚实的数学基础，数值实验证明了该方法在处理不同程度模糊和噪声时的有效性与鲁棒性。

title: When Data Is Scarce: Scaling Sparse Language Models with Repeated Training
authors: Boqian Wu, Qiao Xiao, Patrik Okanovic, Tomasz Sternal, Maurice van Keulen, Mykola Pechenizkiy, Elena Mocanu, Torsten Hoefler, Decebal Constantin Mocanu
abstract: Scaling laws for dense LLMs under infinite data are well explored, but how sparsity interacts with limited data is not. In this work, we study sparse training in data-constrained regimes where limited unique tokens require multi-epoch training. Our experiments span models up to 1.92B parameters in the fitting set, sparsity up to 93.75%, unique data budgets up to 2.6B tokens, and total training tokens up to 41.6B over 16 epochs; we further validate extrapolation on held-out dense-equivalent models up to 7.68B parameters. We find that: 1. Sparse scaling in data-limited settings: We introduce a scaling law that models loss as a function of active parameters, unique tokens, data repetition, and sparsity, accurately predicting performance across compute and data budgets. 2. Delayed data saturation: sparse training postpones diminishing returns from repeated data, making multi-epoch training more effective. 3. Resource trade-offs: With fixed data, loss-optimal sparsity is moderate ~ 50%, while compute-optimal sparsity is higher and grows with data scale. Overall, sparsity is not just a tool for efficiency, but a mechanism for improving scaling trade-offs under data scarcity. Our code is available at: https://github.com/boqian333/sparse-dc-scaling.
zh_title: 当数据稀缺时：通过重复训练扩展稀疏语言模型
translation: 密集大语言模型（LLM）在无限数据下的缩放定律已得到充分研究，但稀疏性在有限数据下的交互作用尚不清楚。在这项工作中，我们研究了在数据受限（即有限的唯一token需要进行多轮训练）情况下的稀疏训练。我们的实验涵盖了拟合集中高达19.2亿参数的模型、高达93.75%的稀疏度、高达26亿token的唯一数据预算，以及在16个epoch中总计高达416亿个训练token；我们还进一步在高达76.8亿参数的留出密集等效模型上验证了外推性。我们发现：1. 数据受限设置下的稀疏缩放：我们引入了一种缩放定律，该定律将损失建模为激活参数、唯一token、数据重复和稀疏度的函数，从而准确预测不同计算和数据预算下的性能。2. 延迟的数据饱和：稀疏训练推迟了重复数据带来的收益递减，使多轮训练更加有效。3. 资源权衡：在固定数据下，损失最优的稀疏度适中，约为50%，而计算最优的稀疏度更高，且随着数据规模的扩大而增长。总的来说，稀疏性不仅是提高效率的工具，也是在数据稀缺下改善缩放权衡的一种机制。我们的代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/boqian333/sparse-dc-scaling。
tldr: 本文研究了数据受限（需多轮训练）下的稀疏语言模型，提出了一个能准确预测性能的全新缩放定律，并发现稀疏训练能延迟数据饱和，是在数据稀缺下优化缩放权衡的有效机制。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新之处在于将“稀疏训练”与“数据受限（需要多轮训练）”这一实际瓶颈相结合，突破了以往稀疏性仅作为提升计算效率工具的局限，证明了其在缓解数据稀缺方面的独特价值。提出的包含数据重复度的缩放定律具有很高的实用价值，能指导资源受限下的模型设计。局限性在于实验模型规模最大为7.68B，在更超大规模的LLM上的泛化能力仍有待验证。
motivation: 密集大语言模型（LLM）在无限数据下的缩放定律已被广泛研究，但当数据有限、需要通过多轮（multi-epoch）重复训练来弥补唯一Token不足时，稀疏性与受限数据之间的相互作用仍不清楚。
method: 在数据受限（需多轮训练）的场景下系统研究稀疏训练。实验涵盖高达1.92B参数模型、93.75%稀疏度、2.6B唯一Token及16轮共41.6B Token的训练，并在高达7.68B参数的密集等效模型上验证外推性。提出了一种新的缩放定律，将损失（loss）建模为激活参数、唯一Token、数据重复次数和稀疏度的函数。
results: 1. 提出的缩放定律能准确预测不同计算和数据预算下的模型性能。2. 稀疏训练能延迟重复数据带来的边际效应递减（即延迟数据饱和），使多轮训练更加有效。3. 在固定数据下，损失最优的稀疏度约为50%，而计算最优的稀疏度更高，且随着数据规模的扩大而增长。
conclusion: 稀疏性不仅是提高计算效率的工具，更是在数据稀缺情况下改善模型缩放权衡（scaling trade-offs）的重要机制。

title: ASE-26: a curriculum for agentic software engineering as a discipline
authors: Mikael Gorsky
abstract: The work of a professional software engineer has begun to consist, increasingly, of directing agents rather than writing code, and the empirical evidence for the shift is now several years deep. Anthropic's Economic Index puts automation at 79 per cent of Claude Code interactions [2]; Handa and colleagues at Anthropic find AI exposure for Computer Programmer tasks at approximately 75 per cent of the role's distinct activities [3]; Brynjolfsson and colleagues at Stanford's Digital Economy Lab report a 13 per cent relative decline in employment for workers aged 22 to 25 in occupations most exposed to AI [4]. The shift is also unfinished, and the academic literature on agentic software engineering converges on the finding that the missing capability is not better models but structured practitioner discipline. This paper presents ASE-26, a comprehensive undergraduate curriculum for agentic software engineering as a discipline, deposited as a citable reference on Zenodo under CC BY-ND 4.0 [12]. The paper sets out the discipline framing the curriculum rests on, the conceptual contributions it makes (most importantly, the evolutionary spiral as the operational form of the co-evolution of intent and build), the twenty-one-module structure that organises the discipline for teaching, the pedagogical commitments that follow from grading work co-produced with an agent, what graduates leave with, and how the discipline as taught is designed to outlast the specific capabilities of today's models. The position the paper takes is that the practitioner skills the industry currently lacks are precisely the skills the discipline names, and that structured undergraduate curricula in agentic software engineering are the principal mechanism by which the gap closes.
comment: 12 pages, 20 references. Companion paper to the ASE-26 curriculum deposited on Zenodo at doi:10.5281/zenodo.20468021. Part 1 of a planned series of two pre-prints on the curriculum and its conceptual core
zh_title: ASE-26：作为一门学科的智能体软件工程课程体系
translation: 专业软件工程师的工作已开始越来越多地转变为引导智能体，而非编写代码，且支持这一转变的经验证据已积累数年。Anthropic的经济指数显示，Claude Code交互中自动化比例达到了79%；Anthropic的Handa及其同事发现，计算机程序员任务在角色不同活动中的AI暴露率约为75%；斯坦福大学数字经济实验室的Brynjolfsson及其同事报告称，在受AI影响最大的职业中，22至25岁工作者的就业率相对下降了13%。这一转变尚未完成，关于智能体软件工程的学术文献一致表明，缺失的能力并非更好的模型，而是结构化的从业者纪律。本文介绍了ASE-26，这是一个全面的智能体软件工程本科课程体系，作为可引用文献托管在Zenodo上，采用CC BY-ND 4.0许可。本文阐述了该课程体系所依赖的学科框架、其做出的概念性贡献（最重要的是作为意图与构建协同演化运行形式的演化螺旋）、组织该学科教学的21个模块结构、对与智能体共同完成的作业进行评分所带来的教学承诺、毕业生的收获，以及该学科教学如何设计以超越当今特定模型的能力限制。本文的立场是，行业目前缺乏的从业技能正是该学科所定义的技能，而结构化的智能体软件工程本科课程体系是弥合这一差距的主要机制。
tldr: 本文推出了ASE-26，这是一个包含21个模块的智能体软件工程本科课程体系，旨在通过系统化的高等教育培养行业急需的智能体协同开发纪律与技能。
ai_comments: 本文极具前瞻性，敏锐地捕捉到了软件工程范式向“智能体引导”的历史性转变。其创新之处在于将“智能体软件工程”正式确立为一门独立的教学学科，并系统性地设计了21个模块的课程体系和人机协同下的教学评估机制（如演化螺旋概念）。这对于高等教育适应AI时代具有重要的指导和示范意义。局限性在于，作为一套教学大纲设计，其在实际教学中的落地效果、学生的接受度以及对就业市场的实际促进作用，仍需未来的实践数据来检验。
motivation: 随着软件工程工作从编写代码向引导智能体转变，行业面临的瓶颈不再是缺乏更好的AI模型，而是缺乏结构化的从业者纪律（discipline）。目前行业急需此类技能，但高等教育尚缺乏针对智能体软件工程的系统化课程。
method: 提出了名为“ASE-26”的综合性本科课程体系。该方法围绕21个教学模块展开，引入了“演化螺旋”（evolutionary spiral）作为意图与构建协同演化的运行形式，并制定了针对学生与智能体协同产出作品的教学评估与评分机制。
results: 设计并开源了包含21个模块的智能体软件工程完整本科课程体系（已托管至Zenodo，遵循CC BY-ND 4.0协议）。该课程明确了学科框架、核心概念、教学评估方法、毕业生能力产出，并具备超越当前特定模型能力限制的生命力。
conclusion: 行业目前所缺乏的从业技能正是该学科所定义的技能，而建立结构化的智能体软件工程本科课程体系，是弥合当前行业技能差距、培养未来软件工程人才的核心机制。

title: Expected Value Alignment for Generative Reward Modeling in Formal Mathematics Verification
authors: Shihao Ji, Haotao Tan, Zihui Song, Mingyu Li
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used with formal interactive theorem provers such as Lean 4. Scaling these systems with reinforcement learning or search methods requires process reward models (PRMs) that can evaluate intermediate reasoning steps. Existing reward-model designs expose a practical trade-off. Value-head models provide continuous scores but modify the generative model interface, while generative reward models preserve textual rationales but are poorly matched to continuous floating-point regression because numeric values are split across tokens. We introduce Expected Value Alignment (EVA), a reward-modeling procedure that keeps the surface output discrete while extracting continuous scores from the model's token distribution. The model emits integer scores in a structured JSON format, and EVA computes a continuous score as the expectation over the logits of the corresponding anchor tokens. Training combines the causal language modeling objective with an auxiliary mean squared error loss on these expected values. We instantiate EVA in \textit{Leibniz}, a reward model for Lean 4 formal verification, and evaluate it against zero-shot and reward-modeling baselines. The evaluation demonstrates that continuous logit-based scoring significantly reduces discretization artifacts while retaining the interpretability of generative critiques.
zh_title: 形式化数学验证中生成式奖励建模的期望值对齐
translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地应用于Lean 4等形式化交互式定理证明器中。通过强化学习或搜索方法扩展这些系统需要过程奖励模型（PRMs）来评估中间推理步骤。现有的奖励模型设计面临着实际的权衡：价值头模型提供连续的分数，但改变了生成模型的接口；而生成式奖励模型保留了文本解释，但由于数值被拆分在不同的Token中，它们与连续浮点回归的匹配度较差。我们引入了期望值对齐（EVA），这是一种奖励建模程序，它在保持表面输出离散的同时，从模型的Token分布中提取连续分数。该模型以结构化JSON格式输出整数分数，EVA通过计算对应锚点Token的Logits的期望值来得出连续分数。训练过程将因果语言建模目标与这些期望值上的辅助均方误差损失相结合。我们在用于Lean 4形式化验证的奖励模型Leibniz中实例化了EVA，并将其与零样本和奖励建模基线进行了评估。评估表明，基于Logits的连续评分显著减少了离散化伪影，同时保留了生成式批注的可解释性。
tldr: 本文提出EVA方法，通过计算离散Token分布的期望值来提取连续分数，在保持生成式奖励模型可解释性的同时，提升了Lean 4形式化验证的性能。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于巧妙地利用期望值计算（EVA）架起了离散Token生成与连续数值评分之间的桥梁，既保留了生成式AI的推理可解释性，又获得了价值头模型的高精度连续评分优势。其局限性可能在于对锚点Token的设计和JSON格式的结构化要求较高，且在数学证明以外的其他推理领域的泛化性仍有待验证。
motivation: 在形式化数学验证中，现有的过程奖励模型（PRM）设计面临权衡：价值头模型虽能提供连续分数但修改了生成接口，而生成式奖励模型虽保留了可解释的文本推理，但因数字被拆分为多个Token而难以进行精确的连续浮点回归。
method: 提出期望值对齐（EVA）机制。模型以结构化的JSON格式输出整数分数，EVA通过对相应锚点Token的对数几率（logits）求期望来计算连续分数。训练时，将因果语言建模目标与这些期望值的辅助均方误差（MSE）损失相结合，并在Lean 4验证模型Leibniz中进行了实现。
results: 在Lean 4形式化验证任务中的评估表明，基于EVA的连续对数几率评分显著减少了离散化伪影，在保持生成式批判可解释性的同时，性能优于零样本和现有的奖励建模基线。
conclusion: EVA成功在生成式奖励建模中结合了连续评分的精确性与文本推理的可解释性，为Lean 4等交互式定理证明器提供了更有效的过程奖励模型。

title: Fairness in two-player zero-sum games with bandit feedback
authors: S Akash, Pratik Gajane
abstract: We study two-player zero-sum games (TPZSGs) with bandit feedback under fairness constraints requiring every action to be played with probability at least $α/m$. Existing instance-dependent results target $\textit{pure}$ Nash equilibria, while fairness generically produces $\textit{mixed}$ equilibria, a harder learning target. Our key technical tool is a reparametrization: every fair strategy decomposes as $p = (α/m)\mathbf{1} + (1-α)\widetilde{p}$ with $\widetilde{p} \in Δ_m$, and substituting into the payoff form yields $p^{\top}Aq = \widetilde{p}^{\top}\widetilde{A} q$ for a fair payoff matrix $\widetilde{A} := (1-α)A + α\mathbf{1} c^{\top}$, where $c_j = \tfrac{1}{m}\sum_i A(i,j)$ is the column-mean vector. The fair game on $A$ is then equivalent to a standard zero-sum game on $\widetilde{A}$, so equilibrium existence, KKT structure, and LP basis stability reduce to classical results applied to $\widetilde{A}$. We derive the fair minimax value, fair Nash equilibrium, fair regret, and a clean dual representation showing the price of fairness is at most $α(1-1/m)$ and vanishes whenever the unconstrained equilibrium already has full support. Our main result is an $\widetilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ regret bound for an Explore-Then-Commit algorithm, $\texttt{Fair-ETC-TPZSG}$, applicable to general mixed fair equilibria, together with a discussion of why naive action elimination does not readily improve it. When the fair equilibrium has a single dominant action, equivalently when $\widetilde{p}^{\star}$ is a vertex of $Δ_m$, the bound sharpens to instance-dependent $\widetilde{O}(1/\widetildeΔ(α)^{2})$, where $\widetildeΔ(α)$ is the LP-margin gap.
zh_title: 带Bandit反馈的双人零和博弈中的公平性
